assumptions: Single round, all cards initially available; both fighters start at 40 life
Optional one same-hand bonus burn; main cannot be its own burn
No reactions; no held advantage tokens or token spending
Objectives checked after damage, with empty inventories
Recovery and legal next colors recorded separately; life edge includes capped recovery
Route flexibility and tokens are not converted to damage-equivalent value
Specialized advantage spending is analyzed separately in spender-report.md
Opponent plans weighted equally; damage edges are not match win rates

cards.name: Quick Jab
cards.ability: If you committed no bonus burns this round, gain +2 attack this round.

cards.name: Rushdown
cards.ability: Spend Red advantage: If you deal damage, gain +2 attack next round.
cards.bonus: Gain +3 attack this round. Your opponent gains +1 attack this round.

cards.name: Guarded Strike
cards.ability:
If you take no combat damage, deal 2 damage to your opponent after combat damage.
Objective: Deal damage and take no damage: gain Green advantage.

cards.name: Feint
cards.ability:
If your opponent's main card has a printed block value of 4 or more, gain +2 attack and ignore 3 opposing block this round.
Objective: Deal damage against printed block 4+: gain Yellow advantage.
cards.bonus: If your opponent's main card has a printed block value of 4 or more, gain +3 attack this round. Otherwise, gain +1 attack this round.

cards.name: Combination Strike
cards.ability: Spend up to two different advantages: One spent: +1 attack. Two spent instead: +4 attack, +2 block, and ignore 2 opposing block this round.
